x-bump-note: 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 relaxes top-level `required: [plan]` to a conditional: a research-mode check (carries `verdict`) precedes any plan and names none, so `plan` is required only when `verdict` is absent. Adds optional `reviewer` and `verdict`. Every 1.1.0 document still validates.
description: Prior-art-check sidecar — records conflicts/compatible/silent counts from a pre-review prior-art sweep. Lives at the plan-derivable state/plan-sidecars/<plan-stem>.prior-art-check.md home (moved out of docs/plans/ by docs/plans/2026-07-24-g2-plan-pipeline-sidecar-contract.md C11/D0). applies_to covers both canonical *.prior-art-check.md and legacy *.md.prior-art-check.md forms. status is NOT enumerated — legacy values like 'reviewed'/'complete' vary on disk.

reviewer.description: Agent that ran a research-mode prior-art check.

verdict.description: Research-mode outcome (e.g. DEGRADED). Its presence marks a check that precedes any plan, so `plan` is not required.

plan.description: Repo-relative path to the plan this prior-art check covers.

author.description: Agent that ran the prior-art check.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Not enumerated — legacy values like 'reviewed'/'complete' vary.

conflicts.description: Count of prior-art findings that conflict with this plan.

compatible.description: Count of prior-art findings that are compatible-but-relevant.

silent.description: Count of prior-art findings that are silent (no impact).

title.description: Human-readable label for this prior-art check sidecar.
